notes: Uses 3x3 rotation matrix at rbx+0x10 (NOT quaternion). Schema currently supports only quaternion/euler. Matrix-to-quaternion conversion needed in driver layer. struct_base_reg = rbx confirmed by MOVDQU [rbx+0x10].
